rationale: The Latin anchor *mundare* in its Biblical context ("nemo eorum mundatus est, nisi Naaman Syrus" — Luke 4:27, the cleansing of Naaman the Syrian from leprosy) refers to ritual/spiritual purification, not physical distillation. This aligns with purify.v.02 ("make pure or free from sin or guilt"), which covers both ritual and moral cleansing, rather than the chemical/physical sense of purify.v.01.
